releases.description: The /preview/releases build log became the Change-Approval Board — a lighter applied-changelog where every entry is a date, a short description of the change, and a link to any knowledge article about it. Reads a live box data file so entries can be appended with no redeploy.
Collaborator topic-navigation: collaborators now land on the topic(s) they're bound to, with module tabs hidden for anything they lack a grant on — a cleaner, permission-aware nav (#5 usability).

Per-key activity drill-in for bridge API keys (#3 C3): each key now has a per-use activity log you can open from settings, completing the audit-history trio (generation history + usage count + activity log).

Shipped the live Winslow status board (/preview/status) and this build log (/preview/releases), both reading box data files (roadmap.json / preview-releases.json) at request time — so status and change updates appear with no redeploy.

API-key usage tracking (#3 C2): every authenticated bridge call bumps a use-count + last-used timestamp in one atomic keyed update, surfaced in settings as 'Last used <when> · N uses'. Failed / revoked / expired keys never count.
API-key generation history (#3 C1): each minted bridge key records issuer, date, name and scope, with a history list that includes revoked and expired keys.

Fine-grained module RBAC went complete (#5 C1+C2+C3): role hierarchy admin > support > licensee > collaborator, a licensee grant/revoke per-module checkbox grid behind a 2FA step-up, and a fail-closed enforcement gate keyed on (role + topic binding + module grant).

Unified settings connectivity hub + platform association (#2 + #4): multiple bridge/partner keys per consuming app plus AI-model provider keys (Claude · Grok · Gemini · OpenAI) with priority and default-model selection, each key associated with a target platform from the integrations directory.

2FA-gated key reveal + Empire Integration Bridge provider surface went live — topic, customer and Winslow-orchestration record providers (roadmap · next-steps · context · activity), connected and live into QuickerBiz.

The multi-provider AI topic engine went live: an OpenAI + Grok/xAI + Gemini model ladder with per-(user, provider) keys and cascade-on-exhaustion (Gemini gemini-3.x-flash live and free at the top), plus the ops-MCP to run the agent crew on your own Claude subscription or a metered API key.
